_comment: Default acceptance checklist for the StarNet crew station. Copy, edit, and pass with --check. Exit code is 0 only when every item PASSes.
items: The crew list names every crew member: NOVA, FOREMAN, RESEARCHER, ENGINEER, ANALYST, WRITER, SCOUT, OPERATOR
The working/idle counter shows at least one agent as WORKING, not 0 WORKING
The COMMS panel is connected and does NOT say 'connecting'
Every message visible in COMMS is prefixed with the name of the agent that sent it, for example [RESEARCHER] or [ENGINEER]
The COMMS panel does not repeat the same line over and over (no wall of identical filler)
The station floor canvas is drawn large and populated with agent figures and nameplates
Agents that are working carry a bubble above their head naming the real tool and target they are using; agents that are idle carry no bubble
PAUSE ALL / RESUME ALL and STOP ALL controls are present in the top bar
No error badge, red X, or 'last run failed' marker is shown against a crew member that is supposed to be working
Nothing is frozen on a spinner, blank panel, or placeholder text
